{"draft": "Bio-Techne returns to GAAP profit in fourth quarter as sales edge higher

Bio-Techne Corporation reported fourth-quarter net sales rose 1% to $321.2 million, with organic revenue growth climbing 3% compared with the prior year.

GAAP earnings were $0.35 per diluted share, swinging from $(0.11) a year earlier, while adjusted EPS slipped to $0.52 from $0.53. GAAP operating income reached $74.3 million, compared with an operating loss of $23.9 million last year, and GAAP operating margin widened to 23.1% from (7.5)%.

Adjusted operating income grew to $103.4 million from $101.3 million in the same quarter last year. In Protein Sciences, net sales increased to $231.2 million, up 2% from $226.5 million, while the segment operating margin eased to 42.0%.

Diagnostics and Spatial Biology net sales held steady at $90.1 million as organic revenue jumped 8%, and the segment operating margin improved to 11.2%.

For the full year, the company said net sales remained flat at $1.2 billion. GAAP EPS climbed to $1.16 per diluted share, while adjusted EPS edged up to $1.93.

Bio-Techne also noted its previously announced agreement to be acquired for $73 per share in cash, representing a total enterprise value of approximately $11.3 billion."}
